toll.means: In the 12 months to September 2026, 1,334 people died on Australian roads. The straight path to halving the 2018–2020 toll by 2030 allowed about 812. That is 522 more deaths than the path. Each full year from 2021 to 2025 was higher than the year before, and January to September 2026 (1,001) is already above the same months of 2025 (973). It is the highest January–September toll since 2009. Those 1,001 deaths already pass the full-year ceiling for 2026, which is 798.
